title: Meta drops out of a major clean energy pact as its natural gas buildout accelerates
summary: Meta has made significant investments in natural gas over the past year. Now it's dropping out of an industry renewable energy group.
llm_summary: Meta, the tech giant, is backing away from renewable energy efforts by leaving a major industry group focused on clean energy. This move comes as the company continues to invest in natural gas infrastructure, a shift that's sparking controversy among environmentalists. The decision highlights a potential disconnect between Meta's public sustainability goals and its current actions.
